subject: mathematics
question_text: Find the area of the triangle formed with the points A(1,2,3), B(2,3,1) and C(3,1,2).

mark_split.label: Find the two side vectors from A

recall_prompt: Say how you would find the area of a triangle from three points.

steps.label: Find AB and AC
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both vectors must start at the SAME vertex — A here. Two sides from one corner is what spans the triangle.
steps.memory_tip: Both vectors must start at the SAME vertex — two sides from one corner span the triangle.
lines: OA = i + 2j + 3k, OB = 2i + 3j + k, OC = 3i + j + 2k

recall.must_convey: That two side vectors AB and AC are built from the same vertex A by subtracting position vectors.
accept: find AB and AC by subtracting OA, both starting from A
take two sides from the same corner A
AB is OB minus OA and AC is OC minus OA
A nunchi rendu sides AB and AC teeskovali
build two edge vectors from the same vertex

steps.why: The cross product of two vectors gives the area of the PARALLELOGRAM they span. Both must start at one point for that parallelogram to sit on the triangle.
common_mistakes: Using AB and BC, which do not share a start point.

steps.label: Find AB×AC
steps.margin_note: Second mark. All three components come out as −3, which is a good sign the arithmetic is right.
steps.memory_tip: All three components come out −3, which is a good sign the arithmetic is right.

recall.must_convey: That AB×AC is computed as a determinant and comes to −3i − 3j − 3k.
accept: cross AB with AC to get minus three i minus three j minus three k
the cross product has all components minus three
take the cross product of the two sides
AB cross AC anni components minus three
compute the determinant for AB cross AC

steps.why: The magnitude of this cross product is the area of the parallelogram on AB and AC — and the triangle is exactly half of it.
common_mistakes: Reversing the order, which flips the sign but not the magnitude.

steps.label: Find the magnitude
steps.margin_note: Third mark. √27 is not final — 27 = 9 × 3, so it simplifies to 3√3. Leaving a surd unsimplified costs marks.
steps.memory_tip: √27 is not final: 27 = 9 × 3, so it simplifies to 3√3.

recall.must_convey: That the magnitude is √27, which simplifies to 3√3.
accept: the magnitude is root twenty seven which simplifies to three root three
nine plus nine plus nine is twenty seven so the modulus is three root three
root twenty seven equals three root three
root twenty seven, simplify cheste three root three
take the modulus and simplify the surd

steps.why: Every square in a magnitude is positive, so the minus signs disappear before the root is taken.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to square the negatives, giving a negative sum.

steps.label: Halve for the area
steps.margin_note: Last mark. The cross product gives the parallelogram; the triangle is half of it. And the answer is an AREA, so say square units.
steps.memory_tip: The cross product gives the PARALLELOGRAM, so halve it. And say square units.

recall.must_convey: That the triangle area is half the magnitude of the cross product, giving 3√3/2 square units.
accept: the triangle is half the parallelogram so the area is three root three over two square units
halve the magnitude to get three root three by two
area is half of AB cross AC which is three root three over two
half teeste three root three by two square units
the area is three root three divided by two square units

steps.why: A parallelogram splits into two congruent triangles along its diagonal, which is exactly why the factor is one half and not something else.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the half and giving the parallelogram area.
